vibe_rationale: Community sauna gathering with capped numbers and Aufguss rituals, a deep niche scene that is a little more commercial because a sauna franchise runs it.
fit_notes: The most direct wellness match in New Zealand, with heat, cold-water and recovery culture for a health-engaged adult crowd. Brand-owned and capped, so access is closed, though a product or education role (hydration, recovery) is the natural shape; it is a New Zealand event.
